title: DG Algebra Structures on Mapping Cones with an Application to Edge Ideals
summary: We generalize a construction of Herzog and Takayama pertaining to differential graded algebra structures on mapping cones. Via this generalization, we provide the minimal free resolution of the edge ideal of a new graph built from suspension over a vertex cover of an old graph, and we discuss when this process preserves differential graded algebra structure on the respective resolutions.
